title: Jampi Ekzos
subject: an old-Malay mantera growled at the modified motorbike exhausts that roar past your window at two every Sunday morning
caption: Malay mystic death metal in the old-Malay incantation style. Guitars down-tuned to B standard, alternating tremolo-picked minor riffs with palm-muted chug riffs and short technical runs; blast beats and continuous double-kick drums that drop to half-time grooves for the breakdown; a distorted bass locked tight to the guitars; a short serunai reed melody over a single deep gong strike in the intro only. Dense and dark, guitars wall to wall, the kick tight and clicky, the spoken incantation dry and up front in the breakdown. Deep guttural male growls throughout, with a low spoken male voice reciting the old-Malay incantation in the breakdown. 180 BPM, B minor. Furious, sleepless and deadly serious. No clean sung chorus, no metalcore melodic hooks, no pop structure, no autotune, no synth pads, no 80s hard-rock solo.
lyrics:
[Intro - serunai melody over one gong strike, then a blast beat]

[Verse 1]
Dua pagi, malam Ahad
Bergema dari simpang empat
Ekzos dibelah, ekzos ditebuk
Tiga puluh jentera mengaum ke tingkapku

[Chorus]
Hai ekzos, hai ekzos
Aku tahu asal-usulmu
Asal besi dari bumi
Pulanglah engkau ke bumi

[Verse 2]
Kaca tingkap bergegar
Anak jiran terjaga menangis
Kucingku lari ke bawah almari
Tiga malam Ahad aku tak lelap

[Breakdown - half-time chug riff, spoken incantation]
Hai jentera bersuara guruh
Jika engkau lalu lagi malam ini
Nescaya rantaimu putus di simpang
Nescaya minyakmu kering di tengah jalan

[Chorus]
Hai ekzos, hai ekzos
Aku tahu asal-usulmu
Asal besi dari bumi
Diamlah engkau sampai Subuh

[Outro - blast beat cuts to one gong strike]
Diam.

[Song ends abruptly]
